title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋~Millennium Dome roof
focus: 以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護~A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep
summary: 千禧巨蛋並非結構意義上的穹頂，而是由 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿以吊索與拉索撐起的穹形索網，上覆 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕。課程從索網與桅桿的傳力、輕屋蓋的荷載反轉出發，處理膜材選擇、索夾與吊索節點、地面組裝後絞升索網、索長精度與預張力，再談風洞試驗的雷諾數問題、索力現場量測、2022 年風暴後的膜片更換，以及改建為 The O2 時的荷載管理。~The Millennium Dome is not a dome in the structural sense but a dome-shaped cable net held up by hanger and tie-down cables from 12 masts about 100 m high and clad in PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric, the whole roof weighing less than the air inside. The course starts from the load path of net and masts and load reversal on a lightweight roof, then covers fabric choice, clamps and hanger nodes, winching the ground-assembled net, cable-length accuracy and pretension, Reynolds-number issues in wind-tunnel tests, field measurement of cable forces, panel replacement after the 2022 storm and load control during conversion to The O2.

units.anchor: 徑向索網與 12 支桅桿~Radial net and 12 masts
units.title: 不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統~A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system
units.mechanism: 千禧巨蛋的屋面由徑向布置的鋼索網構成，屋面劃分為 72 個區段，索網在中段由 12 支桅桿頂端垂下的吊索提起，外緣則以壓制索與周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁固定。索網只能受拉，靠曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載；桅桿則把吊索拉力轉成軸壓傳到基礎，並以拉索平衡。與混凝土或鋼構穹頂不同，這種屋蓋沒有受壓殼面，形狀完全由索長、吊點位置與預張力決定，所以結構重量極輕，卻對荷載方向變化非常敏感。~The Millennium Dome roof is a cable net laid out radially and divided into 72 segments; in its middle zone the net is lifted by hanger cables from the tops of 12 masts, and at its edge it is held by tie-down cables and a perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam. The net works only in tension, resisting out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension, while the masts turn hanger forces into axial compression delivered to their foundations and balanced by stays. Unlike a concrete or steel dome there is no compression shell; the shape is set entirely by cable lengths, hanger positions and pretension, so the structure is extremely light yet very sensitive to changes in load direction.
units.model: 72 個區段平分圓周，半徑 r 處的徑向索間距 s = 2πr/72：r = 50 m 時約 4.4 m，r = 160 m 時約 14.0 m。若外緣一段徑向索受荷寬 14 m、荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 8.4 kN/m，吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m，水平張力 H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN。荷載、跨距與垂度為教學假設。~With 72 segments sharing the circumference, radial cable spacing at radius r is s = 2πr/72: about 4.4 m at r = 50 m and about 14.0 m at r = 160 m. If an outer radial cable carries a 14 m width at 0.6 kPa, w = 8.4 kN/m; with a span of L = 25 m between hanger points and sag f = 1.0 m, the horizontal tension is H = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×25²/8 ≈ 656 kN. Load, span and sag are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性索網分析（考慮大變位）建立初始平衡形狀，再施加各荷載組合，檢查每根索的最大張力與最小張力，確認任何組合下都不會鬆弛；把桅桿軸力、拉索力與環梁反力和簡化手算比較，確認傳力路徑閉合。~Establish the initial equilibrium shape with a geometrically nonlinear cable-net analysis, then apply each load combination and check the maximum and minimum tension in every cable to confirm none goes slack in any combination; compare mast axial forces, stay forces and ring-beam reactions with simplified hand calculations to confirm the load path closes.
units.failure: 以線性分析設計索網會嚴重誤判內力，因為索網的勁度隨形狀與張力改變；若某一區段預張力不足，強風時索鬆弛、膜面拍打，荷載突然轉到相鄰索，引起連鎖過載或膜片撕裂。~Designing a cable net by linear analysis badly misjudges forces, because net stiffness changes with shape and tension; if one segment has too little pretension, its cables go slack in strong wind, the fabric flaps and load jumps to neighbouring cables, causing cascading overload or fabric tears.
units.misconception: 千禧巨蛋是一個由鋼骨撐起的半球形穹頂。~The Millennium Dome is a hemispherical dome held up by a steel frame.
units.practice: 索網結構的設計文件須以非線性分析為準，並列出每根索的設計張力範圍（最小與最大），作為施工張拉與日後檢測的依據；任何改變吊點或索長的變更都要重新做整體分析。~Design documents for a cable net must be based on nonlinear analysis and list each cable's design tension range, minimum and maximum, as the basis for erection tensioning and later inspection; any change to hanger points or cable lengths requires a new global analysis.

units.anchor: 比空氣還輕的屋頂~A roof lighter than the air inside
units.title: 輕屋蓋的荷載反轉：風吸力控制~Load reversal on a light roof: wind uplift governs
units.mechanism: Buro Happold 指出整個屋頂的重量比室內空氣還輕。重量輕意味著自重幾乎無法壓住屋面，風吹過低矮的穹形時在頂部與迎風前緣產生吸力，淨荷載方向由向下轉為向上。索網必須同時承受積雪等向下荷載與風吸力等向上荷載，兩種情況下都要保持受拉，因此需要相反曲率或壓制索提供向下的約束，再以預張力使網在兩個方向都有勁度。對輕屋蓋來說，吸力往往比雪載更控制設計。~Buro Happold notes that the whole roof weighs less than the air inside the building. Low weight means self-weight can barely hold the roof down; wind over a low dome shape creates suction over the crown and windward edge, reversing the net load from downward to upward. The net must carry downward loads such as snow and upward loads such as suction while staying in tension in both, so tie-down cables or opposite curvature provide downward restraint and pretension gives the net stiffness in both directions. On a lightweight roof, suction often governs the design more than snow.
units.model: 室內容積約 2.2×10⁶ m³，空氣 1.2 kg/m³，空氣質量約 2,640 t。以直徑 320 m 的平面 π×160² ≈ 80,400 m² 計，屋頂重量上限約 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m²，即約 0.32 kPa。若陣風速 35 m/s，q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa，吸力係數 −1.0 時淨上揚約 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa。風速與係數為教學假設。~The enclosed volume of about 2.2×10⁶ m³ at 1.2 kg/m³ holds about 2,640 t of air. Over a 320 m diameter plan of π×160² ≈ 80,400 m², the roof weight is therefore below about 2,640,000/80,400 ≈ 33 kg/m², about 0.32 kPa. With a 35 m/s gust, q = ½ρV² ≈ 0.75 kPa, and a suction coefficient of −1.0 gives a net uplift of about 0.75 − 0.32 ≈ 0.43 kPa. Wind speed and coefficient are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 荷載組合表須包含「最小自重加最大吸力」與「最大自重加雪載」兩種極端，並以非線性分析檢查每根索、壓制索與地錨在兩者下的張力範圍；地錨與環梁要以上拔力為主要檢核項目，並確認基礎重量或樁抗拔力有足夠安全係數。~The load-combination table must include both extremes, minimum self-weight with maximum suction and maximum self-weight with snow, and nonlinear analysis must check the tension range of every cable, tie-down and anchor in both; ground anchors and the ring beam must be checked primarily for uplift, confirming adequate safety factors from foundation weight or pile tension capacity.
units.failure: 若只以向下荷載設計而低估吸力，壓制索與地錨的拉力不足，強風時屋面上浮、索網形狀翻轉，膜片承受設計外的應力而大面積撕裂；輕量屋蓋的風損往往從邊緣與開口附近開始。~Designing only for downward load and underestimating suction leaves tie-downs and anchors short of capacity, so in strong wind the roof lifts, the net shape inverts and the fabric sees unintended stress and tears over large areas; wind damage to light roofs often starts at edges and openings.
units.misconception: 屋頂越輕越安全，因為需要承擔的荷載越少。~The lighter a roof the safer it is, because it has less load to carry.
units.practice: 輕屋蓋的設計基準要明確寫出最小自重的取值與吸力的來源（規範或風洞），並把地錨抗拔試驗列為施工停止點；完工後任何移除屋面配重或附屬物的計畫，都要回頭檢查上拔。~The design basis of a light roof must state the minimum self-weight used and the source of suction values, code or wind tunnel, and make anchor pull-out tests a construction hold point; after completion any plan that removes roof weight or attachments must be rechecked for uplift.

units.anchor: 1 mm PTFE 玻璃纖維膜~1 mm PTFE-coated glass fabric
units.title: PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜與材料選擇~PTFE-coated glass fabric and material choice
units.mechanism: 屋面原規劃使用 PVC 塗覆聚酯膜，後來改為 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，厚約 1 mm，內側另有提供保溫與吸音的內襯，並以 144 片膜片組成 72 個區段。PTFE 玻纖膜強度高、不燃性佳、抗紫外線且表面不易附著污垢，使用壽命遠長於 PVC 聚酯膜；但玻璃纖維怕折，運輸與安裝時不能對折或踩踏折痕，且膜材幾乎不能延伸，裁剪精度要求高。膜片在索之間張緊，局部曲率決定膜面應力，平坦的膜片在吸力下張力會急遽升高。~The roof was originally planned in PVC-coated polyester but changed to PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric about 1 mm thick, with an inner liner for thermal and acoustic performance, and 144 panels forming the 72 segments. PTFE-glass is strong, highly fire resistant, UV stable and sheds dirt, giving a far longer life than PVC-polyester; but glass fibres dislike folding, so panels must not be creased or walked on during transport and installation, and the fabric barely stretches, so cutting accuracy is critical. Panels are tensioned between cables and their local curvature governs membrane stress, so a flat panel sees sharply higher tension under suction.
units.model: 膜片在兩條支承之間局部單向彎曲時 T = p·R，R = s²/(8f) + f/2。取支承間距 s = 4 m、垂度 f = 0.25 m，R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m；吸力 p = 0.75 kPa 時 T ≈ 6.1 kN/m。若垂度只剩 0.1 m，R ≈ 20.05 m，T ≈ 15.0 kN/m，約 2.5 倍。間距、垂度與吸力為教學假設。~Where a panel curves locally in one direction between two supports, T = p·R with R = s²/(8f) + f/2. With support spacing s = 4 m and sag f = 0.25 m, R = 16/2 + 0.125 ≈ 8.1 m; at a suction p = 0.75 kPa, T ≈ 6.1 kN/m. If the sag is only 0.1 m, R ≈ 20.05 m and T ≈ 15.0 kN/m, about 2.5 times larger. Spacing, sag and suction are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 膜材每批做經緯向條帶拉伸、撕裂、塗層附著與雙軸試驗，並保存樣品作為日後比對；裁片後量測尺寸，安裝前檢查有無折痕與塗層破損；完成後量測膜面局部垂度，抽查是否有平坦或皺褶區。~Test each batch of fabric for warp and fill strip tension, tear, coating adhesion and biaxial response, retaining samples for later comparison; measure cut panels before installation and inspect for creases and coating damage; after installation measure local sag of the fabric and spot-check for flat or wrinkled zones.
units.failure: PTFE 玻纖膜在搬運時被折出折痕，玻璃纖維斷裂形成弱線，數年後在反覆風吸力下沿折痕撕裂；裁片偏大使膜面鬆弛、出現皺褶與拍打，加速磨損，偏小則安裝時過度張拉、邊緣應力集中。~A PTFE-glass panel creased in handling breaks glass fibres along a weak line that tears years later under repeated suction; panels cut too large go slack, wrinkle and flap, accelerating wear, while panels cut too small are over-tensioned at installation with stress concentrated at the edges.
units.misconception: 膜材越厚越強，所以應該儘量選厚膜並把它拉得越緊越好。~Thicker fabric is always stronger, so choose the thickest fabric and pull it as tight as possible.
units.practice: 膜材規格應寫明強度、塗層、防火等級、透光率與壽命期望，並規定運輸捲筒直徑、禁止對折與安裝時的保護措施；任何材料替代（例如由 PTFE 玻纖改為其他膜）都要重新評估強度、伸長與防火，經設計者核可。~The fabric specification should state strength, coating, fire classification, light transmission and expected life, and set the shipping roll diameter, a ban on folding and protection during installation; any material substitution, such as changing from PTFE-glass to another fabric, must be re-evaluated for strength, stretch and fire and approved by the designer.

units.anchor: 索夾與吊索節點~Cable clamps and hanger nodes
units.title: 索夾、吊索與壓制索的節點細部~Clamps, hangers and tie-down node details
units.mechanism: 吊索從桅桿頂端垂下，以索夾抓住徑向索，把網的荷載轉到桅桿；壓制索與周邊錨定則把網往下拉住。索夾靠螺栓夾緊產生的摩擦力抵抗沿索方向的滑移，但鍍鋅螺旋鋼索在受拉後直徑會縮小、表面鍍層也會潛變，螺栓夾緊力隨時間下降，夾具可能滑動，改變索網形狀與內力分布。節點還要容許索在不同荷載下的角度變化，避免在夾具出口處產生彎曲疲勞。~Hangers drop from the mast tops and grip the radial cables with clamps that transfer net load to the masts, while tie-downs and edge anchorages pull the net down. A clamp resists slip along the cable by friction generated by bolt clamping, but galvanised spiral strand shrinks in diameter under tension and its zinc coating creeps, so bolt clamping force falls over time and the clamp may slip, changing net shape and force distribution. The node must also accommodate changes in cable angle under different loads to avoid bending fatigue where the cable leaves the clamp.
units.model: 索夾滑移阻力 F = 2μN（兩個摩擦面）。若沿索方向需抵抗 150 kN、摩擦係數取 0.1，所需總夾緊力 N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN，4 支螺栓各約 188 kN。若索徑縮小與鍍層潛變使夾緊力損失 20%，剩 600 kN，抗滑僅 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN，小於 150 kN 的需求。數值為教學假設。~Clamp slip resistance is F = 2μN for two friction faces. To resist 150 kN along the cable with μ = 0.1, the total clamping force needed is N = 150/(2×0.1) = 750 kN, about 188 kN for each of 4 bolts. If cable diameter reduction and coating creep cost 20% of the clamping force, 600 kN remains and slip resistance is only 2×0.1×600 = 120 kN, below the 150 kN demand. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 索夾做足尺滑移試驗，在設計張力下的索上量測開始滑移的荷載，與計算比較；安裝時以扭力或張力控制螺栓預拉力並標記索夾位置；完工後數月再複緊一次，之後定期檢查索夾上的標記線是否移位。~Perform full-scale slip tests on clamps fitted to cable at design tension, measuring the load at onset of slip and comparing with calculation; at installation control bolt pretension by torque or tension and mark the clamp position on the cable; re-tighten a few months after completion, then periodically check whether the marker lines on clamps have moved.
units.failure: 索夾鬆動滑移後，吊點沿索移動，局部膜片被拉緊或放鬆，出現皺褶與拍打；夾具出口邊緣若無圓弧，索在風振下反覆彎曲，外層鋼絲斷裂，最後在吊點附近斷索。~When clamps loosen and slip, hanger points move along the cable, tightening or slackening local panels so they wrinkle and flap; a clamp exit without a rounded edge bends the cable repeatedly in wind, breaking outer wires until the cable fails near the hanger.
units.misconception: 索夾螺栓鎖緊一次就能永久維持夾緊力。~Clamp bolts tightened once keep their clamping force forever.
units.practice: 索夾設計要規定預拉力、複緊時程與滑移標記方法，並在維護手冊中列出每個索夾的編號與檢查週期；更換或調整任何吊索前，須由結構工程師評估臨時荷載轉移。~Clamp design should specify pretension, re-tightening schedule and slip-marking method, and the maintenance manual should list every clamp by number with its inspection interval; before replacing or adjusting any hanger, the structural engineer must assess the temporary load transfer.

units.anchor: 地面組裝與絞升索網~Ground assembly and winching
units.title: 桅桿豎立與索網絞升~Mast erection and winching the net
units.mechanism: 施工時先豎立 12 支桅桿並以拉索穩定，再把索網在地面鋪設、連接索夾，然後以絞車經吊索把整張網拉升到位，最後才安裝膜片。索網在提升過程中呈大垂度的懸鏈形，張力很小；隨著網被拉起、垂度減少，索的水平張力急遽上升。由於最終形狀由已裁好的索長與吊點決定，提升過程主要是控制幾何與同步，而不是用千斤頂力量去決定索力。整個屋頂結構在約 15 個月內完成。~Construction first raised the 12 masts and stabilised them with stays, then laid the cable net out on the ground, fitted the clamps and winched the whole net into position through the hangers, installing the fabric last. During lifting the net hangs as a deep catenary with low tension; as it rises and its sag reduces, horizontal cable tension climbs steeply. Because the final shape is fixed by prefabricated cable lengths and hanger points, lifting is mainly about controlling geometry and synchronisation rather than setting cable forces by jack force. The roof structure was delivered in about 15 months.
units.model: 一段徑向索自重 w = 0.2 kN/m、跨距 L = 100 m。提升初期垂度 f = 10 m，H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN；拉到垂度 2 m 時 H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN，張力增為 5 倍，而垂度只少了 8 m。索重、跨距與垂度為教學假設。~A radial cable length weighs w = 0.2 kN/m over a span L = 100 m. Early in the lift with sag f = 10 m, H = wL²/(8f) = 0.2×100²/80 = 25 kN; pulled up to a 2 m sag, H = 0.2×10,000/16 = 125 kN, five times higher for only 8 m less sag. Cable weight, span and sag are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 提升前核對每根索的標記長度與索夾位置；提升中監測各絞車的拉力與吊點高程，確保各桅桿同步上升，並觀察桅桿頂位移與拉索力；到位後量測索網節點座標，與設計形狀比較，偏差超過允許值時找出是索長、索夾位置還是桅桿傾斜造成。~Before lifting, check each cable's marked length and clamp positions; during lifting monitor each winch's pull and hanger-point levels so all masts rise together, watching mast-top movement and stay forces; once in position survey net node coordinates against the design shape, and where deviations exceed tolerance identify whether cable length, clamp position or mast inclination is responsible.
units.failure: 各絞車不同步時，先被拉緊的區段承受大部分重量，索夾可能滑動或桅桿頂受到不平衡水平力而傾斜；若在大風中提升，大面積索網像帆一樣擺動，纏繞或撞擊桅桿與拉索。~Unsynchronised winches leave the first-tightened zone carrying most of the weight, so clamps may slip or mast tops tilt under unbalanced horizontal force; lifting in strong wind lets the large net sway like a sail and tangle with or strike masts and stays.
units.misconception: 索網的最終索力是由提升時絞車拉多大力決定的。~The final cable forces in a net are set by how hard the winches pull during lifting.
units.practice: 索網提升計畫須列出提升階段、各階段的絞車力與吊點高程預測、同步容許差、風速上限與緊急停止方法，並以施工階段分析驗證；由專業承包商、結構設計者與現場安全負責人共同核可，作為停止點管理。~A net-lifting plan must list lifting stages with predicted winch forces and hanger levels, synchronisation tolerance, wind limit and emergency stop method, verified by construction-stage analysis; it is approved jointly by the specialist contractor, structural designer and site safety lead and managed as a hold point.

units.title: 索長精度與預張力的關係~Cable length accuracy and pretension
units.mechanism: 以固定長度索組成的索網，預張力不是在現場用千斤頂調出來，而是由工廠裁切的無應力長度與吊點、錨點位置共同決定。索長誤差會轉成張力誤差：在近乎拉直的索中，幾毫米的長度差就會造成明顯的力差，而在垂度大的索中影響較小。因此索在工廠要在規定張力下量測長度並做標記，溫度也要修正；現場只保留少量可調端部，用來吸收基礎與桅桿的施工誤差。~In a net made of fixed-length cables, pretension is not adjusted on site by jacks but set by the unstressed lengths cut in the factory together with hanger and anchor positions. Length errors become tension errors: in a nearly straight cable a few millimetres produce a noticeable force difference, while a cable with large sag is less sensitive. Cables are therefore measured and marked in the factory under a specified tension with temperature correction, and only a small amount of adjustable end fitting is kept on site to absorb construction errors in foundations and masts.
units.model: 近乎拉直的索張力誤差 ΔT ≈ EA·ΔL/L。取 E = 160 GPa、A = 2,000 mm²，EA = 320,000 kN；100 m 長的索若長度短 10 mm，ΔT ≈ 320,000×10/100,000 = 32 kN，若設計預張力 200 kN，即誤差 16%。同一根索溫度降 20°C、α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，等效 ΔT ≈ 320,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 77 kN。數值為教學假設。~For a nearly straight cable, ΔT ≈ EA·ΔL/L. With E = 160 GPa and A = 2,000 mm², EA = 320,000 kN; a 100 m cable 10 mm too short gains ΔT ≈ 320,000×10/100,000 = 32 kN, a 16% error on a 200 kN design pretension. A 20°C temperature drop with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C in the same cable is equivalent to ΔT ≈ 320,000×12×10⁻⁶×20 ≈ 77 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每根索在工廠以規定預拉荷載量測長度，記錄量測溫度並換算到參考溫度，在索上標出索夾與端部位置；現場安裝前抽查標記，安裝後以分析模型比較實測形狀與張力，確認誤差落在設計允許的張力範圍內。~Measure every cable in the factory under the specified pre-load, record the measuring temperature and correct to the reference temperature, marking clamp and end positions on the cable; spot-check the marks on site before installation and compare measured shape and tension with the analysis model afterwards, confirming errors stay within the permitted tension range.
units.failure: 工廠量測未做溫度修正，冬季量的索在夏季安裝時偏長，整區索網預張力不足而鬆弛；可調端部用盡仍無法對位時，現場若自行加長或縮短索，會在相鄰區段形成張力突變。~Factory measurement without temperature correction makes cables measured in winter too long when installed in summer, leaving a whole zone under-tensioned and slack; when adjustable ends run out and fit-up fails, ad-hoc lengthening or shortening on site creates abrupt tension changes in neighbouring zones.
units.misconception: 索網的預張力可以在完工後隨時用千斤頂任意調整。~Cable-net pretension can be adjusted freely with jacks at any time after completion.
units.practice: 索的製造規範應規定量測荷載、溫度修正方法、長度允差與標記方式，並附索長表；現場任何長度調整都須記錄並送設計者確認，超出可調範圍時停工檢討，而不是現場切割或加接。~The cable fabrication specification should set the measuring load, temperature correction, length tolerance and marking method, with a cable-length schedule attached; every site length adjustment must be recorded and confirmed by the designer, and adjustment beyond the available range stops work for review rather than cutting or splicing on site.

units.anchor: 低矮穹形的風洞模型~Low dome wind-tunnel model
units.title: 風洞試驗與雷諾數效應~Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects
units.mechanism: 低矮的穹形屋面上，氣流在頂部附近加速並可能分離，吸力大小與分離位置取決於曲面形狀與流態。在風洞縮尺模型中，雷諾數比實尺度小數百倍，光滑曲面上的分離點可能與實際不同，因此量到的吸力可能偏高或偏低。工程上常以表面粗糙化、提高風速或多種模型比較來處理，並把結果轉成屋面分區的壓力係數。屋面上的開口（例如隧道通風豎井穿過的缺口）會造成局部風壓集中，也需要單獨評估。~Over a low dome, flow accelerates near the crown and may separate, and the suction magnitude and separation point depend on the surface shape and flow regime. In a scaled wind-tunnel model the Reynolds number is hundreds of times smaller than at full scale, so separation on a smooth curved surface may occur in a different place and measured suctions may be too high or too low. Engineers handle this by roughening the model surface, raising tunnel speed or comparing several models, then turn the results into zoned roof pressure coefficients. Openings in the roof, such as the cut-out for a tunnel ventilation shaft, concentrate local pressures and need separate assessment.
units.model: 雷諾數 Re = VD/ν，ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s。實尺度 V = 30 m/s、D = 365 m 時 Re ≈ 7.3×10⁸；1:300 模型 D ≈ 1.22 m、風洞風速 15 m/s 時 Re ≈ 1.2×10⁶，相差約 600 倍。若風洞風速提高到 30 m/s，差距縮為約 300 倍，但仍無法完全模擬。風速與縮尺為教學假設。~Reynolds number Re = VD/ν with ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s. At full scale, V = 30 m/s and D = 365 m give Re ≈ 7.3×10⁸; a 1:300 model with D ≈ 1.22 m at 15 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.2×10⁶, about 600 times smaller. Raising tunnel speed to 30 m/s narrows the gap to about 300 times but cannot close it. Speeds and scale are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在不同風速下重複量測壓力係數，檢查係數是否隨風速趨於穩定（雷諾數不敏感）；比較光滑與粗糙化模型的分離位置；把風洞結果轉成分區壓力，與規範值比較，取較不利者，並對開口邊緣做局部評估。~Repeat pressure-coefficient measurements at several tunnel speeds and check whether coefficients stabilise with speed, indicating Reynolds insensitivity; compare separation positions on smooth and roughened models; convert results into zoned pressures, compare with code values and use the more adverse, with local assessment at opening edges.
units.failure: 直接採用光滑縮尺模型量到的吸力而不檢討雷諾數效應，可能低估頂部吸力，使壓制索與膜片設計不足；忽略開口邊緣的局部風壓，膜片可能從開口附近先被撕開。~Taking suctions directly from a smooth scaled model without considering Reynolds effects can underestimate crown suction and undersize tie-downs and fabric; ignoring local pressures at opening edges lets panels tear first near the opening.
units.misconception: 風洞模型只要幾何比例正確，量到的壓力就能直接用於實尺度。~If the wind-tunnel model is geometrically correct, its pressures apply directly at full scale.
units.practice: 曲面屋蓋的風洞報告應說明雷諾數處理方法、模型表面處理、風速敏感度試驗與分區壓力的取值原則；結構設計者須確認開口、邊緣與突出物都有對應的局部壓力。~The wind-tunnel report for a curved roof should explain the Reynolds-number treatment, model surface finish, speed-sensitivity tests and how zoned pressures were chosen; the structural designer must confirm that openings, edges and protrusions all have corresponding local pressures.

units.anchor: 錨端頂升量測索力~Lift-off measurement at anchorages
units.title: 索力與膜張力的現場量測~Field measurement of cable and fabric tension
units.mechanism: 索網完成後，必須確認實際張力與設計相符，因為索長、索夾位置與桅桿傾斜的誤差都會改變力的分布。在可調錨端，可用液壓千斤頂做頂升試驗：慢慢加壓，直到錨具剛好離開承壓面，此時千斤頂力即等於索力。其他位置則以振動頻率法、應變計或量測節點座標反算張力；膜面張力以專用膜張力計或觀察皺褶分布評估。所有量測都要記錄溫度與風況，才有比較基準。~After the net is complete, actual tensions must be confirmed against design, because errors in cable length, clamp position and mast inclination all change force distribution. At adjustable anchorages a hydraulic lift-off test can be used: pressure rises slowly until the anchor just leaves its bearing face, at which point the jack force equals the cable force. Elsewhere tension is back-calculated from vibration frequency, strain gauges or surveyed node coordinates; fabric tension is assessed with a membrane tensiometer or by the pattern of wrinkles. Every measurement must record temperature and wind as the basis for comparison.
units.model: 頂升試驗索力 F = p·A。千斤頂活塞面積 A = 200 cm² = 0.02 m²，錨具離開承壓面時油壓 p = 30 MPa，F = 30×10⁶×0.02 = 600 kN。若設計範圍 550 至 650 kN，合格；若千斤頂摩擦使讀值偏高 3%，真實索力約 582 kN，仍在範圍內。數值為教學假設。~In a lift-off test the cable force is F = p·A. With a jack piston area A = 200 cm² = 0.02 m² and an oil pressure p = 30 MPa when the anchor leaves its bearing, F = 30×10⁶×0.02 = 600 kN. Against a design range of 550 to 650 kN it passes; if jack friction makes the reading 3% high, the true force is about 582 kN, still within range. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 頂升用千斤頂與壓力錶須在有效校正期內，校正證書附在量測紀錄中；每個量測點記錄時間、溫度、風速與鄰近施工狀態，並與分析模型在相同溫度下的預測比較；以抽樣方式用第二種方法（例如頻率法）交叉驗證。~Lift-off jacks and gauges must be within calibration, with certificates attached to the records; record time, temperature, wind speed and nearby construction status at every point and compare with model predictions at the same temperature; cross-check a sample by a second method such as the frequency method.
units.failure: 千斤頂未校正或量測時忽略溫度，可能把正常的溫度變化誤判為張力不足，而去錯誤地調整索長；頂升時加壓過度把錨具頂離太多，反而改變了該索與相鄰索的張力。~Uncalibrated jacks or ignoring temperature may mistake normal thermal change for low tension and lead to wrongly adjusting cable lengths; over-pressurising during lift-off and pushing the anchor too far changes the tension in that cable and its neighbours.
units.misconception: 索網外觀形狀正確，就表示每根索的張力都符合設計。~If the net looks the right shape, every cable's tension matches the design.
units.practice: 完工驗收應包含張力量測計畫：量測點分布、方法、溫度修正與允收範圍，結果建立為往後檢測的基準；頂升試驗屬高壓液壓作業，須由合格人員依核准程序執行並設警戒區。~Completion acceptance should include a tension-measurement plan with point distribution, methods, temperature correction and acceptance ranges, with results kept as the baseline for future inspection; lift-off testing is high-pressure hydraulic work to be done by qualified personnel under an approved procedure with an exclusion zone.

units.anchor: 受損膜片與更換程序~Damaged panels and replacement
units.title: 膜面老化、風損與膜片更換~Fabric ageing, storm damage and panel replacement
units.mechanism: PTFE 玻纖膜壽命長，但強度會隨紫外線、反覆彎折與風拍逐年下降，局部破口在風吸力下會迅速擴大。2022 年 2 月風暴 Eunice 撕裂了屋面數個區段，各報導指出約 6 至 8 個區段受損、約 6,000 m² 屋面暴露；由於 PTFE 膜的備料期約一年，業主先以臨時覆蓋保護室內。這說明膜屋面的設計必須考慮單片更換：每一片膜要能在不破壞相鄰片與不使索網失衡的條件下拆除與重新張拉。~PTFE-glass fabric lasts a long time, but its strength falls year by year under UV, repeated flexing and flapping, and a local hole grows quickly under suction. In February 2022 Storm Eunice tore several roof segments, reports citing about 6 to 8 damaged segments and about 6,000 m² of roof left open; because PTFE fabric had a lead time of about a year, the owner first installed a temporary cover to protect the interior. Membrane roofs must therefore be designed for single-panel replacement: each panel must be removable and re-tensionable without damaging its neighbours or unbalancing the net.
units.model: 膜材初始條帶強度 140 kN/m、設計張力 25 kN/m，安全係數 140/25 = 5.6。若老化使強度降為 80%（112 kN/m），係數 4.5；若再出現破口使局部應力集中係數 2.0，有效係數只剩 112/(25×2.0) ≈ 2.2。強度、設計張力與集中係數為教學假設。~With an initial strip strength of 140 kN/m and a design tension of 25 kN/m, the safety factor is 140/25 = 5.6. If ageing reduces strength to 80% (112 kN/m), the factor is 4.5; if a hole adds a local stress-concentration factor of 2.0, the effective factor drops to 112/(25×2.0) ≈ 2.2. Strength, design tension and concentration factor are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以繩索或高空作業目視檢查膜面破口、磨損、接縫剝離與邊緣夾具；從可更換的位置裁取小樣做拉伸試驗，追蹤強度隨年份的變化；風暴後立即檢查並記錄損壞範圍，評估相鄰索與膜片的張力是否改變。~Inspect periodically by rope access or aerial work for holes, abrasion, seam peeling and edge clamps; cut small samples from replaceable locations for tensile tests to track strength over the years; after a storm inspect immediately, record the damaged extent and assess whether tension in adjacent cables and panels has changed.
units.failure: 小破口未即時修補，強風中撕裂沿膜片擴大到整個區段，雨水進入室內；更換時若未先控制相鄰膜片與索網張力，拆下一片膜可能讓相鄰片過度受力而連帶撕裂。~A small hole left unrepaired grows across the whole segment in strong wind and lets rain in; replacing a panel without first controlling the tension of neighbouring panels and the net can overload the adjacent panels so they tear too.
units.misconception: PTFE 膜屋面是永久性的，不需要考慮更換。~A PTFE membrane roof is permanent and never needs replacement planning.
units.practice: 業主應保存膜片編號圖、裁片圖與張拉程序，並評估是否需要備存備用膜材或與供應商約定供料期；膜片更換屬高空與張拉作業，須由結構工程師核可拆裝順序與臨時措施後才能施工。~The owner should keep the panel numbering plan, cutting patterns and tensioning procedure and consider holding spare fabric or agreeing supply lead times with the supplier; panel replacement involves work at height and tensioning, and may start only after the structural engineer approves the removal sequence and temporary measures.

units.anchor: 改建 O2 的荷載管理~Load control in the O2 conversion
units.title: 從千禧展館到 The O2：再利用與交接~From Millennium Experience to The O2: reuse and handover
units.mechanism: 千禧巨蛋在 2000 年展覽結束後，於 2007 年改建為 The O2，室內新建約 20,000 座的室內場館，其鋼屋頂約 4,500 t，獨立支承，不掛在原有索網上；部分原有基樁也被再利用。索網屋蓋屬於輕量張力結構，對集中荷載與吊掛非常敏感，因此改建時新增的燈光、廣告、維修步道與攀登設施，都必須有獨立的支承或經過重新分析。交接文件因此要清楚界定哪些構件屬於屋蓋系統、可承受多少附加荷載。~After the exhibition closed at the end of 2000, the Millennium Dome was converted into The O2, reopening in 2007 with an indoor arena of about 20,000 seats whose steel roof of about 4,500 t is independently supported rather than hung from the original net; some original piles were reused. A cable-net roof is a lightweight tension structure very sensitive to concentrated loads and rigging, so new lighting, signage, maintenance walkways and climbing facilities added in the conversion needed independent support or fresh analysis. Handover documents must therefore define clearly which components belong to the roof system and how much additional load they can take.
units.model: 若在跨距 25 m、垂度 1.0 m 的徑向索中點吊掛 10 t（P ≈ 98 kN），附加水平張力 ΔH ≈ PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN，幾乎等於該索原有的約 656 kN，使張力接近加倍。若垂度為 2.0 m，ΔH 約減半為 307 kN。荷載與幾何為教學假設。~Hanging 10 t (P ≈ 98 kN) at midspan of a radial cable with a 25 m span and 1.0 m sag adds a horizontal tension ΔH ≈ PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN, almost equal to the cable's existing tension of about 656 kN, nearly doubling it. With a 2.0 m sag, ΔH roughly halves to 307 kN. Load and geometry are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 任何新增在屋蓋上或屋蓋下的附掛物都要提出計算與圖說，由結構工程師以非線性模型檢查索力、索夾與膜片；活動或改裝完成後檢查索夾標記、膜面皺褶與錨端狀態，確認沒有未經核准的附掛。~Every attachment added on or below the roof must be submitted with calculations and drawings for the structural engineer to check cable forces, clamps and fabric in the nonlinear model; after events or alterations inspect clamp marks, fabric wrinkles and anchorages to confirm there are no unapproved attachments.
units.failure: 活動承包商把燈具或廣告直接綁在索上，看似只是幾噸，卻使局部索力倍增、索夾滑移與膜片撕裂；改建時若未區分新舊結構的責任，日後檢測與維修會互相推諉，問題長期無人處理。~Event contractors tying lights or banners directly to cables add only a few tonnes, yet locally double cable forces, slip clamps and tear panels; if responsibilities for new and old structures are not separated during conversion, later inspection and repair are passed back and forth and problems linger unresolved.
units.misconception: 索網屋蓋那麼大，多掛幾噸設備不會有影響。~A cable-net roof is so large that a few extra tonnes of equipment make no difference.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含索網分析模型、每根索的設計張力範圍、索長表、索夾編號與預拉力、膜片編號圖、允許附掛的位置與荷載，以及新舊結構的責任界面；任何附掛或改裝須經結構工程師書面核准。~Handover should include the cable-net analysis model, design tension range for each cable, cable-length schedule, clamp numbers and pretension, panel numbering plan, permitted attachment points and loads, and the responsibility interface between new and old structures; any attachment or alteration requires the structural engineer's written approval.

example: 設計練習：評估在一根徑向索上增掛設備的影響。該索吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m、受荷寬 14 m，均布荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m，原水平張力 H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN。現擬在跨中吊掛 10 t 設備，P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN，以集中荷載近似附加 ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN，總張力約 1,269 kN，為原值的 1.93 倍。若索的設計上限為 1,000 kN，就不可行；改成在兩個吊點附近各掛 5 t，跨中彎曲效應大減，附加張力可降到原值的一小部分（需以非線性模型重算）。若把垂度設計成 1.5 m，H₀ ≈ 438 kN、ΔH ≈ 409 kN，總計約 847 kN。所有數值為教學假設，不代表千禧巨蛋的設計值。~Design exercise: assess the effect of hanging equipment from one radial cable. The cable spans L = 25 m between hangers with sag f = 1.0 m and a 14 m loaded width; at 0.6 kPa, w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m and the original horizontal tension is H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN. Hanging 10 t at midspan, P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN, adds by the point-load approximation ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN, a total of about 1,269 kN or 1.93 times the original. Against a design limit of 1,000 kN this is not acceptable; hanging 5 t near each of the two hanger points greatly reduces the midspan effect and the added tension falls to a small fraction (to be recomputed with a nonlinear model). Designing the sag as 1.5 m gives H₀ ≈ 438 kN and ΔH ≈ 409 kN, about 847 kN in total. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Millennium Dome.
history: 千禧巨蛋由 Richard Rogers Partnership 設計，Buro Happold 擔任結構與機電工程顧問，McAlpine 與 Laing 聯合承攬，1997 年 6 月開工，屋頂結構在約 15 個月內完成，造價約 4,300 萬英鎊。它以 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成，屋面原規劃為 PVC 聚酯膜後改為 PTFE 玻纖膜，膜材由 Chemfab 供應、Birdair 安裝，並獲英國皇家工程院 MacRobert 獎。展覽於 2000 年結束，2007 年改建為 The O2 重新開放，2022 年風暴 Eunice 撕裂數個膜面區段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Millennium Dome was designed by Richard Rogers Partnership with Buro Happold as structural and services engineer and built by a McAlpine–Laing joint venture; work began in June 1997 and the roof structure was delivered in about 15 months for about £43 million. It combines 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-coated glass fabric; the roof, first planned in PVC-polyester, was changed to PTFE-glass supplied by Chemfab and installed by Birdair, and the project won the Royal Academy of Engineering MacRobert Award. The exhibition closed in 2000, the building reopened as The O2 in 2007, and Storm Eunice tore several fabric segments in 2022. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 屋蓋整體直徑約 365 m，內部膜面直徑約 320 m，中心高約 52 m~The roof is about 365 m across overall, the inner canopy about 320 m, with a central height of about 52 m
12 支鋼桅桿各高約 100 m~Twelve steel masts each stand about 100 m high
索網使用約 70 km 的高強度鋼索~The cable net uses about 70 km of high-strength steel cable
屋面分為 72 個區段，由 144 片膜片組成~The roof is divided into 72 segments made from 144 fabric panels
PTFE 塗覆玻纖膜厚約 1 mm，內側另有保溫吸音內襯~The PTFE-coated glass fabric is about 1 mm thick, with an inner thermal and acoustic liner
室內容積約 220 萬 m³，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕~The enclosed volume is about 2.2 million m³, and the whole roof weighs less than the air inside
周邊鋼筋混凝土環梁寬約 6 m、深約 0.5 m，承受索網的水平與豎向力~A perimeter reinforced-concrete ring beam about 6 m wide and 0.5 m deep takes horizontal and vertical forces from the net
屋頂結構約 15 個月完成，造價約 4,300 萬英鎊~The roof structure was delivered in about 15 months for about £43 million
